# Contamos

Contamos is a shared ledger for people who share money: couples, flatmates,
families, side projects or any group with a common pot. A ledger keeps
accounts, cards and cash across multiple currencies, logs income and
expense transactions with tags, and shows balances per currency, fiat and
crypto alike, without converting everything into a single blended number.
Every transaction stores the exchange rate of the day it happened. Free
plan available, no card required; Pro removes the free plan's account,
member and transaction limits.

- Homepage (English): http://127.0.0.1:8000/en
- Homepage (Spanish): http://127.0.0.1:8000/es
- Sign up / log in: http://127.0.0.1:8000/login
